name: experimental_metadata
title: Experimental metadata (comprehensive)
description: One row per production dataset, capturing lab / cell line / differentiation / IGVF accessions / pipeline parameters. Hand-curated from per-dataset documentation; chemistry/MOI/spacer-tag fields auto-extracted from each dataset's pipeline config.

marker_conventions.?: Value not yet known / needs to be filled in by the team.
marker_conventions.-: Not applicable / does not exist (e.g., dataset not on portal yet).
marker_conventions.0: Used in numeric columns to mean unknown (kept numeric).

fields.name: dataset_id
fields.description: Canonical long-form ID (matches tf_perturb_seq/datasets/<id>/, primary key).

fields.name: guide_pools
fields.description: Pool letters used (e.g., ABCD, ABCDF). Pool F is an additional set used by Hon CM and Gersbach hepatocyte; only pool A-D guide metadata is mirrored to Synapse.

fields.name: n_measurement_sets
fields.description: Number of measurement sets (10x lanes / pools).

fields.name: pipeline_run_label
fields.description: The current 'official' pipeline RUN_LABEL for this dataset.

fields.name: pipeline_config
fields.description: Filename of the pipeline config file for this dataset's current production run.

fields.name: gcs_output_path
fields.description: GCS output prefix for the current production run.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Free-text caveats, run history pointers, lab-specific quirks.

sources.name: DATA.md
sources.purpose: Production dataset table (lab / lineage / portal status).

sources.name: Per-dataset docs
sources.purpose: IGVF accessions, run history, pipeline status, lab-specific notes.

sources.name: Pipeline configs
sources.purpose: Chemistry, multiplexing, guide-assignment, spacer tag, MOI.

sources.name: IGVF portal
sources.purpose: Ground truth for analysis-set / construct-library / guide-file accessions.
